name: Scala
note: Explicit OO/FP fusion on the JVM
runtime: JVM bytecode (also Scala.js and Scala Native); garbage-collected

runtimes.name: JVM (HotSpot)
runtimes.role: Primary target with full Java interop.

runtimes.name: Scala.js
runtimes.role: Compiles to JavaScript for the browser.

runtimes.name: Scala Native (LLVM)
runtimes.role: AOT to native code for fast startup.

compilers.name: Scala 3 compiler (Dotty)
compilers.role: Official compiler for Scala 3, invoked via scalac.

concurrencyModel: Futures, Akka actors, effect systems (cats-effect, ZIO)
